Welcome to the SPIRIT 3.0 - Buildathon - by Dr Shakuntala Misra National Rehabilitation University (DSMNRU), Lucknow!

A hybrid hackathon for shaping innovative solutions in Software Development.

Join the Mandatory WhatsApp group - Click here

About the Opportunity:

SPIRIT 3.0 - Buildathon is a Software Development hackathon presented by Dr Shakuntala Misra National Rehabilitation University (DSMNRU), Lucknow. Designed as an online coding challenge with hybrid participation, it invites teams to develop and present proposed solutions through a focused buildathon experience.

Participants can bring together problem-solving, ideation, technical, presentation, and Software Development Life Cycle skills as they shape their ideas, define key features, select a technology stack, and communicate their solution’s expected impact.

Competition Structure:

The structure for this online coding challenge is as follows:

  • Round 1 – Idea Screening & PPT Submission: Teams must submit an 8–10 slide PPT or PDF presenting their proposed solution. The presentation should cover the problem statement, proposed solution, target users, key features, technology or tech stack, innovation, expected impact, and implementation approach. Presentations exceeding 10 slides will not be considered for evaluation.

Rewards and Prizes:

Rewards & prize details (as provided):

  • Winner of Assistive Technology Theme: Receive ₹1,000 and a certificate in recognition of the winning contribution to the Assistive Technology Theme.
  • Winner of Fintech & Security Theme: Receive ₹1,000 and a certificate celebrating the winning solution in the Fintech & Security Theme.
  • Winner of Open Innovation Theme: Receive ₹1,000 and a certificate honouring the winning Open Innovation solution.
  • Best Project – Up to ₹2 Lakh Incubation Opportunity: Earn recognition for the best project, along with a certificate and an incubation opportunity of up to ₹2 lakh.

Bring your team, sharpen your idea, and take the next step with SPIRIT 3.0 - Buildathon by DSMNRU in its hybrid format.
